chapter.title: MAINTENANCE OF PUBLIC ORDER AND TRANQUILLITY

heading: Magistrate may prohibit repetition or continuance of public nuisance.
text:
A District Magistrate or Sub-divisional Magistrate, or any other Executive Magistrate empowered by the State Government or the District Magistrate in this behalf, may order any person not to repeat or continue a public nuisance, as defined in the Indian Penal Code (45 of 1860), or any special or local law.
C.—Urgent cases of nuisance or apprehended danger
status_note: The Act is repealed. Kept in India Code's 'Repeal Acts' collection; record title reads 'The Code of Criminal Procedure 1973, 02 of 1974 (Rep., Act 46 of 2023)' (read 2026-11-21)
